heading: Why homeowners and property managers choose us.
subtext: What we built the company around — and what 250+ Google reviews and 800+ jobs tell us actually matters to the people who hire us.

cards.title: Four trades, one crew
cards.body: Handyman, electrical, light remodel, and exterior — all eight crew members work under one shop. When a remodel needs an electrical sign-off or a deck repair turns into a gutter fix, the same company handles it. One quote, one invoice, one number to call.

cards.title: Licensed, bonded, insured
cards.body: KS contractor license on file, KS electrical contractor license #E-19842, $2M general liability, $1M workers' comp, and bonded for project work. Certificates of insurance available on request — we email them to HOAs and property managers all the time.

cards.title: Owner-operated since 2014
cards.body: Apex is owned by Dave Reichert and his brother Tim. Started with one truck doing handyman work; grew into four trucks across four trades. Owners are still on every estimate walkthrough and they're who you talk to if something goes sideways.

cards.title: Communication that actually happens
cards.body: Texts when the crew is on the way. Photos at the end of every visit. Written quotes before work starts. Same-day invoicing. The thing other contractors do badly, we built the company around doing well.
